name: suno-music-producer
description: Write, produce, and reimagine Suno music with a bundled MCP server and a workflow tailored to each songwriter.

interface.shortDescription: Write lyrics and produce Suno songs with MCP
interface.longDescription: Write original Suno lyrics and produce or reimagine songs with a reusable skill that discovers each user's songwriting and project preferences, preserves approved source material for covers, and verifies available generation options.
defaultPrompt: Use Suno Music Producer to discover my preferences, write an original song, and prepare it for Suno.
Use Suno Music Producer to prepare a faithful cover using my project preferences.
